name: wave6-local-load-notes
scope: Local single-host createApp with test-double provider + injectable clock for rate-window simulation. Not national-scale. Wall-clock duration is seconds, not a 5-minute soak.

hardware.note: Recorded on agent box; not a declared competition reference machine profile.

g05_acceptance.required: ≥20 concurrent sessions and 1000 synthetic records for 5 minutes; <1% unexpected failures; no lost writes
g05_acceptance.reason: Wave6: 20 concurrent health workers (1000 ok), 1000 direct durable rows, 1000 API writes under simulated rate windows. Wall-clock 3392ms << 5 minutes. Do not mark G05 pass.
